commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  : 
else
  printf '%s\n' disabled > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled"
  echo "SNAP-DISABLED"
fi

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review >/tmp/ext.out 2>/tmp/ext.err; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "--- STDOUT ---"; cat /tmp/ext.out; echo "--- STDERR ---"; cat /tmp/ext.err

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review 2>/tmp/ext.err 1>/tmp/ext.out; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "=STDOUT bytes="; wc -c </tmp/ext.out; echo "=STDOUT head="; head -40 /tmp/ext.out

for f in skills/create-issue/references/step-2-clarify.md skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md skills/review/phases/phase-0-setup.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md skills/docs-verify/references/*.md; do echo "== $f =="; sed -n '1p;$p' "$f" 2>/dev/null; done

for f in skills/create-issue/references/step-2-clarify.md skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md skills/review/phases/phase-0-setup.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md; do echo "== $f =="; head -1 "$f"; tail -1 "$f"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
